description: Beautifully remodeled kitchen sets the tone in this move-in ready Tempe townhome with an attached garage. Featuring quartz countertops, a granite island, white cabinets, upgraded lighting, and stainless steel appliances, this space is designed for everyday living and entertaining. Wood-look vinyl plank flooring runs throughout the first floor, with hardwood stairs leading upstairs. The second level offers a double-primary layout with walk-in closets and a convenient laundry room. Bright, open living spaces create a comfortable flow throughout the home. Enjoy the private backyard patio with artificial turf that's perfect for hosting, relaxing, or giving pets space to play. Walking distance to Cubs Spring Training, Mesa Riverview Park, and minutes to ASU, light rail, and Tempe Marketplace.

description: Featuring two spacious primary suites with ensuite baths, this stylish 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse in the sought-after gated community of Villagio offers both comfort and convenience—plus a rare 2-car garage! The main level boasts a bright open-concept layout with a modern kitchen and new appliances, a dining area, powder room, and a private balcony retreat. Upstairs, both primary suites provide privacy and comfort, with laundry ideally located on the same floor. Enjoy resort-style amenities including lush pet-friendly greenbelts, two sparkling pools with shaded ramadas, and a relaxing spa. Perfectly located near major freeways, ASU, Sky Harbor Airport, Sloan Park, and Tempe Marketplace for premier shopping, dining, and entertainment—this home truly has it all!

description:
Welcome to Villagio at Tempe!

Ideally located near Sloan Park/Cubs Spring Training, Tempe Marketplace, Mesa Riverview, Loop 101 & 202, ASU, plus endless shopping, dining, and entertainment. Perfect lock-and-leave living in the heart of it all!
